name: Brand and Publishing OS
promise: Turn governed brand truth and sourced ideas into approved, traceable publications.
completion_criteria: BrandPackage carries identity, voice, audience, approved claims, assets, rules, version, and provenance.
Downstream consumers cannot silently mutate or republish canonical brand truth.
Brand Workshop's low-typing gated intake exists inside Brand System Maker with state parity.
Source ingest through review, dry-run execution, approval, and metrics retains one traceable chain.
Fixtures never claim real persistence, enrollment, commerce, deployment, or publication without those contracts.

waves.objective: Build a canonical BrandPackage in the suite-local engine and consume it in a downstream dry run.
waves.acceptance: Schema validation, version pinning, provenance, and mutation protection are evidenced, and the receipt is dry-run only with no live publishing side-effect.
waves.runtime_followup: Export the package from the real Brand Maker runtime and consume it in a downstream consumer outside this repository.

waves.objective: Map Brand Workshop's nine phases onto Brand Maker workspace state and gates, extracting phase ids from live brand_workshop/phases.py.
waves.acceptance: All nine phases are read from source and each is mapped, rejected, or retained with a named Maker gate and port action. No phase is implemented in Brand Maker.
waves.runtime_followup: Implement the mapped gates in the real Brand Maker workspace with behavior and recovery evidence per phase.

waves.objective: Model sourced draft to VCC review to dry-run publishing receipt through the suite-local engine.
waves.acceptance: SourceRecord, BrandPackage, claim matching, and dry-run status remain linked on a single receipt. Nothing is submitted to VCC.
waves.runtime_followup: Route a real draft through the actual VCC review path and produce the receipt from that system.

waves.objective: Verify version-pinning and mutation-protection boundaries across two independent suite-local BrandPackage consumers.
waves.acceptance: Both consumers resolve the same pinned package id and version, and mutation protection holds across them.
waves.runtime_followup: Wire a consumer outside this repository and verify the same boundary across a process or repository seam.

waves.objective: Implement the nine Brand Workshop phases as a Brand Maker intake state machine in the suite-local engine.
waves.acceptance: Complete phase inputs drive all nine phases to a canonical BrandPackage without data loss, and empty input completes zero phases and yields no package.
waves.runtime_followup: Move the state machine into the real Brand Maker application and reconcile its existing duplicate intake UX.

waves.objective: Extend the dry-run receipt chain with a simulated VCC human approval gate.
waves.acceptance: Approved, rejected, and unmatched-claim decisions each produce their distinct status, and the approved path stops before live publish, preserving operator publish authority.
waves.runtime_followup: Replace the simulated gate with real human signoff in VCC.
